name: Pes Anserine Bursitis / Tendinobursitis
definition: Pain and tenderness at the pes anserine region on the anteromedial proximal tibia, related to bursal and/or tendon irritation.

typical: Medial knee pain below joint line

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound can help in atypical or injection-planning cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection is selective after diagnosis is clear.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Pain and tenderness at the pes anserine region on the anteromedial proximal tibia, related to bursal and/or tendon irritation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
